The same fitted object is used for publication graphics and guided teaching.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
rsm_plot(fit, type="contour")
rsm_plot(fit, type="heatmap")
rsm_plot(fit, type="surface", interactive=TRUE)
rsm_plot(fit, type="prediction_variance")
rsm_slices(fit, x="N", y="K", slice_factor="Irrigation")
cat(rsm_explain(fit), sep="\n")
```

For models with three or more factors, `rsm_slices()` fixes one factor at several values while keeping any remaining factors at the center of the declared region. This avoids pretending that a high-dimensional response surface can be understood from a single 3D plot.

The optional Shiny interface can be launched with `run_rsm_app()`. The interface is deliberately a thin layer over the package API so that every interactive analysis can also be scripted and tested.
